response.answer: Mohsen Abbaspour Onari is a leading researcher in explainable AI and clinical decision support, known for his highly cited work on trust in interpretable machine learning models. He is currently a Ph.D. candidate at Eindhoven University of Technology. His research focuses on developing trust in explainable intelligent decision support systems.
